evidence.quote: + **`AWSManagedRulesATPRuleSet`** – The rules in this AWS Managed Rules rule group detect, label, and handle various types of account takeover activity. The rule group inspects HTTP `POST` web requests that clients send to the specified login endpoint. For protected CloudFront distributions, the rule group also inspects the responses that the distribution sends back to these requests. For a list of the rule group's rules, see [AWS WAF Fraud Control account takeover prevention (ATP) rule group](aws-managed-rule-groups-atp.md).
